[[Cianwood Gym]] }} '''Scrappy Skarmory''' (Japanese: '''VS エアームド ''' ''VS {{tt|Airmd|Skarmory}}''), titled '''VS Skarmory''' in the [[Chuang Yi]] translation, is the 124th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 34th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Gold, Silver & Crystal}}. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} A man is flying on a {{p|Skarmory}} when he sees something, and has Skarmory get closer. Meanwhile, a man, his {{p|Poliwrath}}, and {{p|Primeape}} stand near a cliff side. The man, whose name is revealed to be [[Chuck]], announces that he'll finally get to battle someone. He makes his way inside the [[Cianwood Gym]] and greets his [[Chuck's wife|wife]]. He instructs her to prepare the battle room so he can battle his friend. After some time and his friend still hasn't arrived, Chuck assures himself that he's always late and that there's no need to worry. Suddenly, Chuck hears a sound and runs outside to see what it is. He is horrified to find his training equipment broken. When he inspects his torn sandbags, he finds a shard of crystal. It's then that his friend's favorite jacket washes up. He wonders who could have defeated him when he sees a shining light in the ocean. He sends his Poliwrath and Primeape after the light, when {{p|Suicune}} appears. But before it can attack, a Skarmory defends Chuck, buying some time. It turns out that the Skarmory's trainer is Chuck's friend, {{adv|Walker}}. Walker was late because of Suicune and he reveals to Chuck that it's one of the Pokémon that awakened from the [[Burned Tower]]. They both decide to work together to try to capture it. After a long and tough battle, Suicune flees, since it doesn't think they are good enough. Walker, though, tells Chuck that he's still a warrior and hasn't changed a bit. Chuck then reveals that his last {{adv|Blue|disciple}} returned to [[Kanto]] four years ago, and is now the [[Gym Leader]] of [[Viridian City]]. They then wonder why Suicune challenged them. They come to the conclusion that it must be looking for a strong Trainer, and if so it must be heading for Blue or for [[Falkner]]. Suicune is then seen heading towards another town far away. ==Major events== * {{DL|Legendary beasts (Adventures)|Suicune}} battles [[Chuck]] and his friend {{adv|Walker}}. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Blue}} (fantasy) * [[Falkner]] (fantasy) * [[Chuck]] * [[Chuck's wife]] * {{adv|Walker}} ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Scizor}} ({{OP|Blue|Scizor}}; fantasy) * {{p|Noctowl}} ([[Falkner]]'s; fantasy) * {{p|Primeape}} ([[Chuck]]'s) * {{p|Poliwrath}} ([[Chuck]]'s) * {{p|Tyrogue}} ([[Chuck]]'s; ×2) * {{p|Skarmory}} ({{adv|Walker}}'s) * {{p|Suicune}} ({{DL|Legendary beasts (Adventures)|Suicune|Adventures}}) * {{p|Hitmonchan}} (statue) * {{p|Hitmonlee}} (statue) ==Trivia== ===Errors=== ==In other languages== {{Epilang|color={{colorschemelight|Johto}}|bordercolor={{colorschemedark|Johto}} |zh_cmn={{tt|VS 盔甲鳥|VS Skarmory}} (Taiwan)
